name: Haiku concentrated AI/technology
strategy: Concentrated exposure to AI infrastructure (chips and cloud), enterprise AI platform leaders, and pure-play AI/analytics companies positioned to benefit from accelerating AI adoption across enterprise and consumer segments through 2026.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This portfolio concentrates on companies leading the AI infrastructure buildout and enterprise AI adoption wave. NVDA, AMD, AVGO, and MRVL provide exposure to essential chip and networking infrastructure. MSFT, GOOGL, META, and AMZN are the dominant AI platform/cloud leaders with proven LLM capabilities and enterprise traction. PLTR and CRWD represent pure-play AI beneficiaries with secular growth tailwinds. Over the next 6 months, continued AI capital expenditure, model deployment acceleration, and enterprise adoption should drive outperformance versus the broader S&P 500.
